description: This file defines a custom implementation of the FilterChain interface for managing and executing a sequence of servlet filters within the OpenMRS module web system. It enables modular filtering by iterating through filters defined in the module system before continuing with the initial filter chain.

classes.name: ModuleFilterChain
classes.description: A custom implementation of FilterChain that manages a sequence of Filters, allowing modules to define their own filters to be applied before proceeding down the main filter chain.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ModuleFilterChain with a specified collection of Filters and an initial FilterChain.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Executes the next Filter in the sequence; if no more filters are present, delegates to the initial filter chain.
